regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow one-narrative regime: Coal is the lone eligible leader (rank 1, score 1.135, crowded, mean-revert, zero breadth) with Banks the only other eligible theme. The detector's own backtest label is explicit that the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold here (mean-reverting tape whipsaws the gate), gate_helps is false, and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0 — so this state is a focus lens with no validated directional edge on this market, and I am defaulting to near-zero directional conviction on theme ranking itself.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks closes the 0.135 score gap to Coal and rotation.directional flips true while Coal's score decays below Banks — that combination would retire this watch and mark the first confirmed eligible-leadership handoff in this narrow regime.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only high-score eligible theme and is the dominant one-narrative leader. The lean rests on the trend/eligibility leg (eligible=true, highest absolute score) being the detector's one historically grounded idea — that staying with an in-trend eligible leader beats fighting a mean-reverting tape — while crowding_z 1.4 and breadth 0.0 are read as size-down cautions, not as a reason to fade.
evidence: hurst_tag=mean-revert but still the only high-scoring eligible theme
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag plus zero breadth and crowded flag on the headline theme is the classic unstable-leadership signature; if the mean-reverting tape is reasserting itself, the leader is most exposed to a sharp drawdown, and the backtest itself says the gate did not hold on this market.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal ETF) underperforms the CSI 300 benchmark by more than 4% cumulative on a close-to-close basis before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only other eligible theme, ranks 2 with a trend hurst_tag and a higher durability_bar (0.56) than Coal, and is the rotation challenger. The lean is not a handoff prediction — it is simply that among eligible themes with trend-health, Banks is the second leg of the narrow eligible universe, so a modest overweight relative to the ineligible majority is the only other trend-consistent stance.
theses.dissent: Banks is crowded (z=1.9) and the margin to Coal is only 0.135 with absorption 0.33 and rotation.directional=false — there is no confirmed handoff, and chasing the challenger in a one-narrative regime has no validated edge.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) underperforms the CSI 300 benchmark by more than 4% cumulative on a close-to-close basis before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
